guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: checkoutservice_cpu rose from 0.41 to 17.87 (+4268%, z=+231) and checkoutservice_mem rose about 12x, while every other service's metrics are flat; it is the only service with a major anomaly. Memory and CPU rose together, so cpu vs mem is ambiguous, and the worst traces show error spans in frontendservice without passing through checkoutservice, so the link to the user-facing latency is not clear. I chose cpu because it has the largest z-score and relative change.

proposed_fix.description: Restart or reschedule the checkoutservice pod, set CPU and memory limits, and inspect it for a runaway process or leak; then check whether the frontend latency recovers.
